mapper.select: SELECT pb.id as id, p.product_image as productImage, p.name as productName, s.name as supplierName, pb.quantity as quantity, pb.import_price as importPrice, pb.created_at as createdAt FROM product_batch pb INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = pb.product_id INNER JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pb.supplier_id ORDER BY pb.id desc LIMIT #{pageRequest.limit} OFFSET #{pageRequest.offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM product_batch pb INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = pb.product_id INNER JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pb.supplier_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_batch(import_price, quantity, product_id, supplier_id) VALUES ( #{productBatchInfo.importPrice}, #{productBatchInfo.quantity}, #{productBatchInfo.productId}, #{productBatchInfo.supplierId} )
